text:
Maya (CEO): Hey team — post-update Q&A here. If you had questions about the reorg or headcount plans, drop them and we'll answer live.
leo_infra (Infra SWE): quick clarifying q: when you say +20 infra hires, is that net or gross? are we replacing contractors?
Priya (Head of People): good question. +20 is net FTEs over the next 12 months. we will convert a small number of contractors where it makes sense but most are new headcount to support dedicated capacity and reliability work.
Sam (Director, Product): how will product team priorities shift with these hires? will roadmap timelines change?
Jonas (VP Eng): product timelines remain prioritized by customer impact. infra/platform hires are meant to reduce blocker queue for product teams, so expect fewer infra-driven delays. no major roadmap reprioritization planned today.
sara_ts (Talent Partner): note for hiring managers: we expect reqs to move faster but hiring bar stays the same. please coordinate with TA on pipeline before opening new reqs.
leo_infra (Infra SWE): are there new roles or will we reuse current job descriptions?
Priya (Head of People): a mix — we have 5 new job profiles (performance engineer, GPU infra eng, runtime ops lead) plus existing SWE/PM roles. updated JDs are in the hiring drive.
Maya (CEO): wanted to reiterate the rationale: past quarter's cuts preserved runway; now we invest in the platform areas that unlock product velocity and cost reductions.
Sam (Director, Product): will there be team-level reorgs or manager changes? some of us saw proposed maps in the doc but not final.
Jonas (VP Eng): a few teams will be restructured to align with serving/runtime domains. manager changes are limited; most moves are lead-level adjustments. we'll publish the final org map by Thursday and notify affected folks directly.
sara_ts (Talent Partner): internal candidates prioritized — please apply via internal portal. hiring panels will include an internal interview slot when relevant.
leo_infra (Infra SWE): if my team interviews someone and they get moved to another team, how is ramp/accountability handled?
Jonas (VP Eng): we will coordinate cross-team onboarding. initial 30/60/90 plans will be agreed by both hiring and receiving managers.
Maya (CEO): we'll hold a deeper session next week specifically on "platform hiring + impact" — calendar invite will go out. any process questions, @Priya and @sara_ts are your go-to.
all-hands-bot: reaction summary: :thumbsup: 14 / :eyes: 6
sara_ts (Talent Partner): followups i'll post after this thread: 1) link to updated JDs, 2) timeline for allocations, 3) how to nominate internal candidates.
leo_infra (Infra SWE): appreciated — thanks for the clarity.
Maya (CEO): thank you all. transparency is priority; keep questions coming and we'll keep updating.
